guarantees.claim: block_swcmd is driven to 1 when err_swsequence is true, or when err_modestrength is true and cfg_en_unsupported_modestrength_i is false, or when err_entropy_ready is true; otherwise block_swcmd is 0.
When EnMasking is true, unused_cfg_entropy_ready is continuously assigned to cfg_entropy_ready.

assumptions.claim: cfg_en_unsupported_modestrength_i must be asserted only when tolerating unsupported mode strength is safe; otherwise a true err_modestrength condition will be masked and block_swcmd will not block operation.
assumptions.risk: Unsafe mode strength configuration goes undetected, potentially allowing faulty cryptographic operation.

uncertain_points.claim: err_entropy_ready is used unconditionally in block_swcmd, but its validity when EnMasking is false is unclear; verify that err_entropy_ready is driven correctly in all modes.
uncertain_points.risk: False assertion of block_swcmd could block valid operations due to err_entropy_ready being uninitialized or stale.

uncertain_points.claim: unused_cfg_entropy_ready is assigned but appears intentionally unused; confirm it serves only as a lint waiver and does not indicate a forgotten connection.
uncertain_points.risk: No direct functional risk, but could obscure a design oversight if the signal is expected elsewhere.

uncertain_points.claim: block_swcmd is a combinational decode; glitches from input changes may propagate to downstream logic unless synchronously sampled or filtered.
uncertain_points.risk: Glitches could cause false error handling if block_swcmd is used asynchronously.
